author: John Gruber

title: Fantastical 4.1.15 Adds Calendar Mirroring
author: John Gruber
summary: Flexibits: Calendar Mirroring allows you to connect two separate calendars (like work and personal) so that events from one automatically show up on the other. The best part? No event information is sent to Flexibits servers or saved outside of your device. You can choose to show full event details or just block the time out as a mysterious, professional “Busy”.
